articles.title: Standard Chartered predicts Arbitrum's ARB to rise 70-fold to $10, citing Robinhood Chain revenue
articles.snippet: The bank expects tokenization to make Arbitrum a favored network for traditional finance, even though ARB holders currently have no direct claim on the fees.

articles.title: Standard Chartered says Arbitrum could outperform Bitcoin, Ether through 2030
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered sees Robinhood Chain as an early sign that tokenization could transform Arbitrum’s economics and drive ARB sharply higher by 2030.

articles.title: Crypto Billionaires Hand Reform UK $97M in Record Donations
articles.snippet: Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne each gave £36 million, and between them beat what every UK party raised last year.
